summary: The note is a short overview of Serbia's participation in the Olympic Games. It states that Serbia first competed in 1912 as the Kingdom of Serbia. It also notes that Serbia returned to the Olympics as an independent team at the 2008 Summer Olympics, after ninety-six years.
one_line: Overview of Serbia's Olympic participation, from its 1912 debut as the Kingdom of Serbia to its 2008 return as an independent team.
key_facts: Serbia first participated at the Olympic Games in 1912.
Serbia competed at the 1912 Olympics as the Kingdom of Serbia.
Serbia returned to the Olympics as an independent team after ninety-six years.
Serbia's return as an independent team took place at the 2008 Summer Olympics.
